usedFor: Lofty holds leads and appointments, and Calendly creates a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Lead Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Lofty, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A fresh lead gets a booking link at once, so the first conversation can be scheduled.

watchOut: “Updated Lead” is a separate trigger in Lofty, so use it only if you want a link on edits too.
